name: tawil-media
description: Frontend asset pipeline for the Tawil Media Django project

scripts.vendor: cp node_modules/htmx.org/dist/htmx.min.js static/js/vendor/htmx.min.js && cp node_modules/alpinejs/dist/cdn.min.js static/js/vendor/alpine.min.js && cp node_modules/gsap/dist/gsap.min.js node_modules/gsap/dist/ScrollTrigger.min.js static/js/vendor/ && cp node_modules/@fontsource/playfair-display/files/playfair-display-latin*-{500,700}-normal.woff2 node_modules/@fontsource/source-sans-3/files/source-sans-3-latin*-{400,600}-{normal,italic}.woff2 node_modules/@fontsource/amiri/files/amiri-arabic-{400,700}-normal.woff2 node_modules/@fontsource/ibm-plex-sans-arabic/files/ibm-plex-sans-arabic-arabic-{400,500,600}-normal.woff2 static/fonts/
scripts.build: npm run vendor && npm run build:css
